Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of
lower back pain and stiffness radiating into the left buttock. The mechanism of the
impact and the force involved are consistent with the injury described. Examination on
intake revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness, rsetricted lumbar range of motion, and
muscle guarding, and imaging obtained during the initial evaluation clearly confirmed
soft tissue injury to the lumbar region. The patient also reported a minor strain to
the same area several years ago, which had resolved completely without lasting
limitation. Over 15 visits, care consisted of manual therapy, guided stretching, and a
home exercise program. Treatment followed a typical course, with visit frequency
reduced as symptoms and mobility improved. At discharge the patient had regained
near-full range of motion and reported minimal residual discomfort. Billing records
reflect single entries for each service with no duplicated charges.

Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
